book.darkrifts.page1:
§5§lDark Rifts Codex§r

A guide to the tears in the world, the blade that opens them, and what waits on the other side.
book.darkrifts.page2:
§5Rift Blade§r

Netherite Sword + 4 Echo Shards + Eye of Ender.

Hold Right Click, look up and drag your view to draw a rift. Sneak + Right Click on a rift closes it.
book.darkrifts.page3:
§5Abilities§r

Press R with the blade in hand.

Rift, Spikes, Step, Collapse, Cloak, Seal, Spike Wave, Void Slash, Void Strike, Drain and Rift Barrier.
book.darkrifts.page4:
§5Dark Mirror§r

Rifts lead to the Dark Mirror: a ruined copy of the world under an eternal night. Thick fog, black trees, dark water and no sun.
book.darkrifts.page5:
§5Void Prison§r

The Seal ability throws a player into the Void Prison. A sealed player respawns there forever. Only the one who sealed them can lift the seal.
book.darkrifts.page6:
§5Rift Armor§r

Netherite piece + 3 Echo Shards + Eye of Ender.

Full set: no fall damage, magic damage halved, Speed I.
book.darkrifts.page7:
§5Ritual Altar§r

Craft: 6 Obsidian, 1 Crying Obsidian, 2 Echo Shards (shards on top corners, crying obsidian between them).
Place it on open ground.
book.darkrifts.page8:
§5The Ritual§r

Right Click the altar with a Nether Star. For twelve seconds the world shakes, runes burn and rifts open. Stay back, and keep the sky above the altar clear.
book.darkrifts.page9:
§5Rift Reaver§r

The altar is consumed and the Reaver climbs out of the tear. It slams the ground, calls spikes and drags you in. At half health it goes berserk.
book.darkrifts.page10:
§5Spoils§r

The Reaver drops a Nether Star, Echo Shards, Ender Pearls and Netherite Scrap.

Good luck, rift-walker.
